e.title: 联合国人口数据门户（含世界人口展望）：按年龄/性别/情景的人口指标 API
e.title_en: UN Population Data Portal (including World Population Prospects): a population API with age, sex and variant dimensions
e.title_hk: 聯合國人口數據門戶（含世界人口展望）：按年齡／性別／情景的人口指標 API
e.summary: 联合国人口司数据平台：实测 API 返回 86 个指标目录，指标元数据自带年龄/性别/情景维度——人口预测正是养老金与年金建模的输入
e.summary_en: The UN Population Division’s data platform: a live API call returned a catalogue of 86 indicators whose metadata carries age, sex and variant dimensions — population projections are exactly the input to pension and annuity modelling
e.summary_hk: 聯合國人口司數據平台：實測 API 返回 86 個指標目錄，指標元數據自帶年齡／性別／情景維度——人口預測正是養老金與年金建模的輸入
e.body:
**联合国人口数据门户（UN Population Data Portal）** 承载**联合国人口司**的人口估计与预测，其中包括最广为人知的 **《世界人口展望》（World Population Prospects, WPP）**。本条属本轮**国际统计数据 API 层**——实测池内 **UN WPP 相关条目为 0**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：人口司门户 `population.un.org/wpp/` HTTP 200（26KB）；数据门户 `population.un.org/dataportal/home` HTTP 200（12.4KB）。⭐ **API 实测可用**——调用 `https://population.un.org/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` 返回 **200、`application/json`、98.5KB**，正文为分页结构（`pageNumber`/`pageSize`/`total`），**共 86 个指标**，每个指标含 **`name`、`shortName`、`description`，以及维度标记 `dimAge`、`dimSex`、`dimVariant`、`dimCategory`** 与默认维度设置——**即「按年龄、按性别、按情景（variant）」是接口契约的一部分**。⚠️ **一处如实记录**：我原本猜测的下载路径 `/wpp/Download/Standard/MostUsed/` 实测返回 **404，且响应体与门户页同为 26KB**（站点对未命中路径返回同一外壳），**故词条不提供该下载路径**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「人口预测」这一层**——本会话上一轮已收 [[who-gho]]（健康与死因）、[[eurostat]]、[[cdc-wonder]]、[[ihme-gbd]]（疾病负担）与 [[worldbank-data]]（社会经济），但**「未来人口结构」此前没有数据源**；而**养老金、年金、长寿风险与产品定价都需要按年龄/性别的人口预测**，池内现有 [[human-mortality-db]] 一系**是历史死亡率**（[[hmdhfdplus]]、[[hmd-jl]]）、[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demotools]]、[[ungroup]]、[[granmomo-rs]] 一类**是建模与投影工具**——**输入端的官方人口预测正是缺的那一块**。**② `dimVariant` 维度在精算上很实用**——联合国的人口预测自带**不同情景（如中位、高、低生育率）**，这意味着**情景分析可以直接从数据层获得，而不必自行假设**，与 [[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[lifeinsurer]] 的寿命/养老金工作直接衔接。**③** 与 [[worldbank-data]]（社会经济指标）、[[who-gho]]（健康）叠加，可构成**「人口 → 健康 → 社会经济」**的跨市场输入层。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的**只是指标目录端点（86 个指标及其维度元数据）**，**未实际拉取任何人口数据序列**，因此**不能确认数据可用性、覆盖国家数与版本**；**②** 站点为**前端门户结构**（页面体积小），**未命中路径会返回同一外壳**（已实测），**故本词条只给已核实的 API 端点与门户页**；**③** 联合国人口预测**每两年左右更新一版**（WPP 版本号），**引用时必须写明版本与取数日期**——本次**未核实当前版本号**；**④** 使用条款**未逐项核实**。**核实说明**：WPP 门户（26KB）、数据门户（12.4KB）与 `/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators`（98.5KB，共 86 指标）均实测；**未拉取任何数据序列、未核实版本号**。
e.body_en:
The **UN Population Data Portal** carries the **UN Population Division’s** population estimates and projections, including the best-known **World Population Prospects (WPP)**. This entry belongs to the current **international statistics API layer** — a measured search found **zero UN WPP-related entries**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): the Division’s portal `population.un.org/wpp/` returned HTTP 200 (26KB); the data portal `population.un.org/dataportal/home` returned HTTP 200 (12.4KB). ⭐ **The API was verified live** — calling `https://population.un.org/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` returned **200, `application/json`, 98.5KB** with a paginated structure (`pageNumber`/`pageSize`/`total`) and **86 indicators**, each carrying **`name`, `shortName`, `description` and the dimension flags `dimAge`, `dimSex`, `dimVariant`, `dimCategory`** plus default dimension settings — i.e. **"by age, by sex, by variant" is part of the interface contract**. ⚠️ **One honest note**: the download path I had guessed, `/wpp/Download/Standard/MostUsed/`, returned **404 with the same 26KB body as the portal** (the site serves one shell for unmatched paths), **so this entry does not offer that download path**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "population projection" layer** — the previous round in this session added [[who-gho]] (health and causes of death), [[eurostat]], [[cdc-wonder]], [[ihme-gbd]] (disease burden) and [[worldbank-data]] (socio-economic indicators), but **future population structure had no source**; and **pensions, annuities, longevity risk and product pricing all require age- and sex-specific population projections**. The corpus’s [[human-mortality-db]] family is **historical mortality** ([[hmdhfdplus]], [[hmd-jl]]) and [[mortalitylaws]], [[demotools]], [[ungroup]], [[granmomo-rs]] are **modelling and projection tools** — **the official population projection on the input side was the missing piece**. **② The `dimVariant` dimension is actuarially useful** — UN projections come with **alternative scenarios (e.g. median, high and low fertility)**, meaning **scenario analysis is available at the data layer rather than needing bespoke assumptions**, connecting directly to longevity and pension work in [[longevity-mortality-investor]], [[retirement-planning]], [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] and [[lifeinsurer]]. **③** Layered with [[worldbank-data]] (socio-economic indicators) and [[who-gho]] (health), it forms a **"population → health → socio-economy"** cross-market input layer.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** what was verified is **the indicator catalogue endpoint only (86 indicators and their dimension metadata)**; **no population series was actually pulled**, so **data availability, country coverage and version cannot be confirmed**; **②** the site is a **front-end portal** (small pages) that **returns the same shell for unmatched paths** (measured), so **this entry gives only the verified API endpoint and portal pages**; **③** UN population projections are **revised roughly every two years** (an WPP version number), so **citations must state the version and extraction date** — **the current version number was not verified here**; **④** terms of use **were not verified item by item**. **Verification note**: the WPP portal (26KB), the data portal (12.4KB) and `/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` (98.5KB, 86 indicators) were all measured; **no data series was pulled and no version number was verified**.
e.body_hk:
**聯合國人口數據門戶** 承載**聯合國人口司**的人口估計與預測，含最廣為人知的**《世界人口展望》（WPP）**。本條屬**國際統計數據 API 層**——實測池內 **UN WPP 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：人口司門戶 HTTP 200（26KB）；數據門戶 HTTP 200（12.4KB）。⭐ **API 實測可用**——`/dataportalapi/api/v1/indicators` 返回 **200、`application/json`、98.5KB**，**共 86 個指標**，每個含 **`name`／`shortName`／`description` 與維度標記 `dimAge`、`dimSex`、`dimVariant`、`dimCategory`**——**即「按年齡、按性別、按情景」是接口契約的一部分**。⚠️ **如實記錄一處**：我猜測的下載路徑 `/wpp/Download/Standard/MostUsed/` **實測 404 且響應體與門戶同為 26KB**（站點對未命中路徑返回同一外殼），**故不提供該下載路徑**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「人口預測」這一層**——上一輪已收 [[who-gho]]、[[eurostat]]、[[cdc-wonder]]、[[ihme-gbd]]、[[worldbank-data]]，但**「未來人口結構」此前沒有數據源**；而**養老金、年金與長壽風險都需要按年齡/性別的人口預測**，池內 [[human-mortality-db]] 一系**是歷史死亡率**，[[mortalitylaws]]、[[demotools]]、[[ungroup]]、[[granmomo-rs]] **是建模與投影工具**——**輸入端的官方人口預測正是缺的那一塊**。**② `dimVariant` 維度很實用**——聯合國預測自帶**不同情景**，**情景分析可直接從數據層獲得**，與 [[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 直接銜接。**③** 與 [[worldbank-data]]、[[who-gho]] 疊加構成「**人口 → 健康 → 社會經濟**」輸入層。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實的**只是指標目錄端點**，**未實際拉取任何人口數據序列**；**②** 站點為**前端門戶結構**、**未命中路徑返回同一外殼**（已實測）；**③** 聯合國人口預測**約每兩年更新一版**，**引用須寫明版本與取數日期**——**本次未核實當前版本號**；**④** 使用條款**未逐項核實**。**核實說明**：三項均實測；**未拉取任何數據序列**。
